capabilities: Search verses by reference in Korean or English, such as John 3:16
Insert verses side by side in Korean and English using template variables
Fetch chapters from GAE, KRV, NIR, ESV and KJV versions on demand
Format inserted verses as a blockquote or a callout
Cache fetched chapters in memory only
extras: Not in the Community plugins directory due to copyright concerns with Bible text; must be installed manually or via BRAT. The plugin id changed from obsidian-bible-search, so existing users must reinstall and re-enter or copy settings. Verse text is fetched from www.bskorea.or.kr and bolls.life (only version, book and chapter are sent), and inserted passages credit the translation unless the source line is turned off.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Bible verses by reference or insert bilingual Korean/English text into a note.
summary: Bible verse search that fetches Korean and English passages on demand and inserts them using a configurable template with optional verse numbers and source line.
